about: Hand transcription of piano-allegro.webp (a photo of a printed beginner piano piece, uploaded by the app's owner), checked note by note against zoomed crops and the note-head positions measured on the photo. Three grand-staff systems (bars 1-5, 6-10, 11-16), BOTH staves in treble clef. Staccato dots, slurs, 'legato', fingering numbers and the pencil marks are left out. Bars 1-8 and 9-16 are each repeated.
